tool_config.name: prepare_pay
tool_config.description: Prepare a payment: to one of her saved people by name, or to anyone by phone number. If they are on Plus it goes to their wallet; if not, they get a code by text to collect cash at any Plus agent. If the result has options, ask her which one. Nothing moves until she taps Yes (or types her PIN) on her screen.

payee.description: Who she wants to pay, in her own words (a saved name).

phone.description: Their phone number, when she pays someone by number.

name.description: Their name, when she pays a new phone number.

amount.description: Amount in naira, a whole number she said ("20k" is 20000). Never guess.
